head: 1c24f289b
head_note: code only, uncompiled (orchestrator compiles every switch on and off, NV and AMD, host twins)

idn_pq_device_codebooks.note: On: IDENTICAL IVF-PQ codebooks from the batched device Lloyd loop (pq_codebooks_device: strided seeds, 3 launches per iteration, one sync) with the pinned fold (ftz partial adds, identical_div centroid), host twin _codebooks_host_batched. Bits change on NV, AMD and the host column together; recall gate vs cuVS. Expected to remove the AMD 145 s taxi codebook stage.

ivf_pq_one_upload_off.note: Rollback arm: the coarse build's rows are uploaded twice and the labels round-trip through the host. Default: resident coarse build with keep_rows hands dx, centres and labels to the residual step; no numpy->List copy under IVF_BUILD_FROM_POINTER.

idn_pq_lut_tiled_off.note: Rollback arm: pq_score_kernel (per-candidate pq_lut_entry when pq_dim x n_codes > LUT_MAX). Default: pq_score_tiled_kernel in IDENTICAL. Same words: ID check owed against the _OFF arm.

idn_pq_scan_fused.note: On: pq_scan_fused_kernel (score + register top-k under the (distance, id) total order) in IDENTICAL for k <= SEL_KM; no candidate buffer, no select chain. Outputs and n_candidates_ the same words.

ivf_pq_resident_fit_off.note: Rollback arm: x_ann_ivf_pq_build_resident is not registered; fit downloads codes and the first search prepares the handle. Default: fit returns a resident handle; codes_ is exported on first read.

kmeans_live_cores_off.note: Rollback arm: the fused assignment grid from gpu_cores_for (108 NV / 110 AMD). Default on NVIDIA/AMD: MULTIPROCESSOR_COUNT (cached). Scheduling only.

ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off.bits_change: only when the k-means|| recluster ran past kmeans_n_iters; device and host columns together
ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off.status: new default per the lane brief (read_ivf.md B2); bit-changing default, flagged
ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off.note: Rollback arm: the recluster runs up to KMeansParams.default()'s 300 iterations. Default: capped at the IVF build's kmeans_n_iters. Recall gate vs cuVS required.

ivf_layout_scatter.note: On: the list layout as per-block rank + list-major table scan + scatter (stable, the radix order) while n_lists x ceil(n / 1024) <= 4 n. Same offsets, ids and words.

ivf_idn_strided_init.note: On: centre c = training row (c n_train) // n_lists (device gather; host the same rows), INIT_ARRAY, no k-means|| seeding. Bits change on every column; recall gate vs cuVS. Makes ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off moot.

expanded:ivf-pq.route: IVFPQIndex.fit -> x_ann_ivf_pq_build_resident [ivf_pq_resident_fit_off] -> _ivf_pq_build_impl: coarse = ivf_flat_build_resident_host keep_rows [ivf_pq_one_upload_off; ivf_idn_strided_init, ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off, kmeans_live_cores_off, ivf_layout_scatter] -> residual -> codebooks (pq_codebooks_device [idn_pq_device_codebooks] or per-subspace kmeans_fit_rows) -> encode; search -> ivf_scan_search score (pq_score_tiled_kernel [idn_pq_lut_tiled_off] / pq_scan_fused_kernel [idn_pq_scan_fused])

ann:ivf.route: IVFIndex.fit -> ivf_flat_build_resident (strided trainset, k-means|| [ivf_idn_strided_init, ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off] + lazy Lloyd with the fused assignment [kmeans_live_cores_off], predict, layout [ivf_layout_scatter]) -> handle
